_readme: Festival greetings for Facebook and Instagram.
On a date listed in 'dates', those two accounts post the matching greeting
at their first slot of the day INSTEAD of the queued marketing post, and
stay quiet for the rest of that day. The marketing post is not consumed --
the queue does not advance -- so it simply goes out at the next slot.
Hindu festival dates move with the lunar calendar, so they cannot be
computed: every date here was checked against a published panchang for
that specific year. When this list runs out, tools/check.py starts warning.
Do not guess a date; look it up.
Cards are typographic -- background plus Poppins, no drawn artwork.

diwali.card_line: May your family be a little less far apart
diwali.english:
Every house will be full of light tonight.

The one that matters is the call you make to the person who is not in the room — the one who moved away for work, the one who could not travel this year, the one you keep meaning to ring.

Happy Diwali from PulseSoul. May your family be a little less far apart tonight.
diwali.hinglish:
Aaj har ghar roshan hoga.

Par sabse zaroori wo call hai jo us insaan ko jaati hai jo aaj kamre mein nahi hai — jo kaam ke liye door chala gaya, jo is baar aa nahi paaya, jisse baat karne ka soch kar aap bhool jaate hain.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Diwali ki shubhkamnayein. Aaj parivaar thoda paas aa jaaye.

chat.message: Tumhara diya bhi jala diya 🪔 Jab tak nahi aate, jalta rahega.
chat.reply: Aa raha hoon 🙏 Video call karte hain abhi

earlier.out: Kal kitne baje aa rahe ho sab?

dhanteras.card_line: The real wealth is who picks up your call
dhanteras.english:
Dhanteras is about what you bring home.

After a certain age you notice the real wealth is the list of people who answer when you ring. That list does not grow on its own — it is kept alive by small messages on ordinary days.

Happy Dhanteras from PulseSoul.
dhanteras.hinglish:
Dhanteras us cheez ke baare mein hai jo aap ghar laate hain.

Ek umar ke baad samajh aata hai ki asli daulat wo log hain jo aapka phone uthate hain. Ye list apne aap nahi badhti — aam dinon ke chhote messages hi ise zinda rakhte hain.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Dhanteras ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Aaj ki puja ho gayi 🪔 Tumhare naam ka bhi diya rakha hai.
chat.reply: Thank you papa 🙏 Shaam ko call karta hoon

bhaidooj.card_line: Some bonds need only one message
bhaidooj.english:
Bhai Dooj asks very little: show up, sit down, eat something.

If distance makes that impossible this year, a call is not a poor substitute. It is the whole thing, just carried differently.

Happy Bhai Dooj from PulseSoul.
bhaidooj.hinglish:
Bhai Dooj zyada nahi maangta: aa jaao, baith jaao, kuch kha lo.

Agar is baar doori ki wajah se ye mumkin nahi, to call koi kam nahi hai. Wahi baat hai, bas alag tareeke se pahunchti hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Bhai Dooj ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Tumhare bina thali adhoori hai bhai 🙏 Ye photo bhej rahi hoon, tilak video call pe.
chat.reply: 5 minute mein call karta hoon didi ❤️

rakhi.card_line: A thread is a promise you keep all year
rakhi.english:
The thread takes a second to tie and a year to honour.

Most of that year is not dramatic. It is answering the phone. It is noticing she has gone quiet. It is the message that says nothing much at all.

Happy Raksha Bandhan from PulseSoul.
rakhi.hinglish:
Dhaaga bandhne mein ek pal lagta hai, nibhane mein poora saal.

Aur wo saal koi filmi nahi hota. Bas phone uthana. Ye dhyaan rakhna ki wo kuch dinon se chup hai. Wo message jismein khaas kuch hota bhi nahi.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Raksha Bandhan ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Tumhari rakhi taiyaar hai bhai 🧵 Courier se aa rahi hai, pehen lena!
chat.reply: Mil gayi ✅ Abhi baandh raha hoon, photo aa rahi hai

earlier.out: Rakhi pe aa nahi paunga is baar 😔
earlier.in: Koi baat nahi, main bhej deti hoon

holi.card_line: Some things are easier said in colour
holi.english:
Holi is the one day nobody stands on ceremony.

Old arguments get buried under colour, and people who had not spoken in months end up laughing on the same street. Worth remembering the rest of the year too.

Happy Holi from PulseSoul.
holi.hinglish:
Holi wo ek din hai jab koi formality nahi bachti.

Purane jhagde rang ke neeche dab jaate hain, aur jo log mahinon se nahi bole, wo ek hi gali mein saath haste mile jaate hain. Ye baat baaki saal bhi yaad rakhne laayak hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Holi ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Bhai rang tumhare liye rakh liya hai 🎨 Video call pe hi laga denge 😄
chat.reply: Haha aa raha hoon, bachke rehna 😂

janmashtami.card_line: The house feels fuller when everyone calls
janmashtami.english:
Janmashtami is a house full of noise — bells, sweets, children awake far too late.

If your family is spread across three cities now, the noise still counts when it comes down a phone line.

Happy Janmashtami from PulseSoul.
janmashtami.hinglish:
Janmashtami matlab ghar bhar ka shor — ghanti, mithai, bacche jo der raat tak jaage rehte hain.

Agar aaj aapka parivaar teen shehron mein bata hua hai, to wo shor phone par bhi utna hi asli hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Janmashtami ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Jhula sajaya hai 🌸 Raat 12 baje jaagna hai, call kar lena.

ganesh.card_line: New beginnings go better with family watching
ganesh.english:
Ganesh Chaturthi begins things.

Whatever you are starting this year — a job, a move, a small business nobody has heard of yet — it goes better when the people at home know about it.

Ganpati Bappa Morya, from PulseSoul.
ganesh.hinglish:
Ganesh Chaturthi shuruaat ka tyohaar hai.

Is saal aap jo bhi shuru kar rahe hain — naya kaam, naya shehar, ya koi chhota business jiske baare mein abhi kisi ko pata nahi — wo tab behtar chalta hai jab ghar walon ko pata ho.

Ganpati Bappa Morya. PulseSoul ki taraf se.

chat.message: Bappa aa gaye ghar 🙏 Is baar tum nahi ho, isliye photo bhej raha hoon.
chat.reply: Ganpati Bappa Morya! Visarjan pe pakka aaunga

navratri.card_line: Nine nights, nine reasons to call home
navratri.english:
Nine nights of getting ready, dancing, eating late and starting again.

Somewhere in those nine days is a good reason to ring the people who taught you the steps.

Happy Navratri from PulseSoul.
navratri.hinglish:
Nau raatein — taiyaari, garba, der raat khana, aur agle din phir wahi.

In nau dinon mein kahin na kahin wo bahana zaroor milega jinhone aapko ye sab sikhaya tha, unhe phone karne ka.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Navratri ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Aaj garba hai society mein 💃 Tumhare bina team incomplete lag rahi hai.
chat.reply: Video call karo raat ko, main wahi se dance karungi 😄

dussehra.english:
Dussehra is about burning what should not be carried any further.

Most families are carrying something small — a misunderstanding nobody has bothered to fix, a call nobody wants to make first. Today is a decent excuse to make it.

Happy Dussehra from PulseSoul.
dussehra.hinglish:
Dussehra us cheez ko jalane ka din hai jo aage nahi le jaani chahiye.

Har parivaar kuch na kuch chhota utha ke chal raha hota hai — koi galatfehmi jo kisi ne sudhaari nahi, koi call jo pehle karne se sab katrate hain. Aaj wo call karne ka accha bahana hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Dussehra ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Ravan dahan dekhne aaye hain 🔥 Tum bachpan mein sabse aage khade hote the.
chat.reply: Yaad hai papa 😊 Video call kijiye na

karva.card_line: Waiting is easier when you can see them
karva.english:
A day built entirely around one person keeping another in mind.

Whatever you think of the fast, that part is worth keeping.

Happy Karva Chauth from PulseSoul.
karva.hinglish:
Ek poora din jiska matlab bas itna hai ki koi kisi ko yaad rakh raha hai.

Vrat ke baare mein aapki jo bhi raay ho, ye baat sambhaal ke rakhne laayak hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Karva Chauth ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Mehendi lag gayi 🌙 Chaand nikle to tumhe hi pehle call karungi.
chat.reply: Main bhi chhat pe wait kar raha hoon 😊

chhath.card_line: Four days that bring everyone home
chhath.english:
Chhath empties cities and fills villages.

For everyone who could not get a ticket this year: the ghat is far away, but the people are one call closer than they feel.

Happy Chhath Puja from PulseSoul.
chhath.hinglish:
Chhath par shehar khaali ho jaate hain aur gaon bhar jaate hain.

Jinhe is baar ticket nahi mila, unke liye: ghat door hai, par log utne door nahi jitna lagta hai — bas ek call ki doori par hain.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Chhath Puja ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Ghat pe aaye hain, subah ka arghya hai 🌅 Tumhare liye bhi prarthana ki.
chat.reply: Thank you maa 🙏 Agle saal pakka aaunga

sankranti.card_line: Someone has to hold the other end
sankranti.english:
Sankranti is the first festival of the year and the least complicated.

Sun, sweets, a rooftop, and somebody holding the other end of the string. That last part is the whole idea.

Happy Makar Sankranti from PulseSoul.
sankranti.hinglish:
Sankranti saal ka pehla tyohaar hai aur sabse simple bhi.

Dhoop, til-gud, chhat, aur koi jo dhaage ka doosra sira pakde ho. Asli baat wahi aakhri wali hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Makar Sankranti ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Chhat pe patang udai 🪁 Tumhari wali abhi bhi sabse upar hai 😄

shivratri.card_line: A quiet night to check on someone
shivratri.english:
A night for staying awake and being quiet at the same time.

If you are up anyway, send a message to whoever came to mind while you were reading this.

Happy Maha Shivratri from PulseSoul.
shivratri.hinglish:
Ek raat jo jaagne ki bhi hai aur shaant rehne ki bhi.

Agar jaag hi rahe hain, to jo naam ye padhte hue dimaag mein aaya, use ek message bhej dijiye.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Maha Shivratri ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Mandir ho aaye 🙏 Raat ko jaagran hai, tum bhi ek diya jala lena.
chat.reply: Jala dunga papa. Har Har Mahadev 🙏

ramnavami.card_line: Every old story is about going home
ramnavami.english:
Strip away everything else and the oldest story we tell is about someone finding their way back to their family.

Happy Ram Navami from PulseSoul.
ramnavami.hinglish:
Sab kuch hata dijiye, to hamari sabse purani kahani bhi yahi hai — koi apne parivaar tak wapas pahunchta hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Ram Navami ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Mandir mein bahut bheed thi 🙏 Prasad tumhare liye rakh liya hai.
chat.reply: Jai Shri Ram 🙏 Sunday aata hoon

independence.card_line: Built in India, for Indian families
independence.english:
PulseSoul was built in India, by one person, for the way Indian families actually talk — grandparents who prefer voice notes, cousins in four cities, a group that never sleeps.

Happy Independence Day.
independence.hinglish:
PulseSoul India mein bani hai, ek hi insaan ne banayi hai, aur bilkul usi tarah ke liye jaise Indian parivaar baat karte hain — dadi-nani jo voice note bhejti hain, cousins jo chaar shehron mein hain, aur wo group jo kabhi sota hi nahi.

Swatantrata Diwas ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Society mein jhanda laga diya 🇮🇳 8:30 baje neeche aa jao

earlier.out: Kal chhutti hai, ghar pe hi hoon

republic.card_line: A country of families, one call at a time
republic.english:
Republic Day, and a small thought: a country is mostly just a very large number of families trying to stay in touch.

Happy Republic Day from PulseSoul.
republic.hinglish:
Republic Day par ek chhoti si baat: desh aakhir mein bahut saare parivaaron ka jod hi to hai, jo ek doosre se jude rehne ki koshish kar rahe hain.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Gantantra Diwas ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: India Gate aaye hain 🇮🇳 Parade dekh ke tumhari yaad aayi.

gandhi.card_line: Small things, done gently, done daily
gandhi.english:
He was right about the small things: gentleness, done daily, adds up to more than one grand gesture.

That is true of families too.

Gandhi Jayanti greetings from PulseSoul.
gandhi.hinglish:
Chhoti cheezon ke baare mein unki baat sahi thi: naramī, roz thodi thodi, kisi ek bade kaam se zyada asar karti hai.

Parivaaron par bhi yahi laagu hota hai.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Gandhi Jayanti ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Aaj bapu ki jayanti pe charkha nikala 🧵 Tumhari dadi ka tha.
chat.reply: Sambhaal ke rakhna maa, agli baar dekhunga ❤️

christmas.card_line: The good part was the table, not the tree
christmas.english:
Whatever your family celebrates, the shape of this day is familiar everywhere: people who do not meet often, in one room, eating too much.

If your room is missing someone this year, call them.

Merry Christmas from PulseSoul.
christmas.hinglish:
Aapka parivaar jo bhi manata ho, is din ki shakal har jagah ek jaisi hai: wo log jo aksar nahi milte, ek kamre mein, zaroorat se zyada khaate hue.

Agar is baar aapke kamre mein koi kam hai, to unhe call kijiye.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Merry Christmas.

chat.message: Ghar pe lights laga di 🎄 Tum aate to aur acchi lagti.
chat.reply: Next weekend pakka! Merry Christmas didi 🎁

newyear.card_line: One resolution worth keeping: call them more
newyear.english:
Most resolutions are about becoming someone else.

Here is an easier one: message the people at home more often than you did last year. It costs nothing and it is the only one anybody will notice.

Happy New Year from PulseSoul.
newyear.hinglish:
Zyadatar resolutions kisi aur insaan ban jaane ke baare mein hote hain.

Ek aasaan wala ye hai: ghar walon ko pichle saal se thoda zyada message kijiye. Isme kuch kharch nahi hota, aur sirf yahi ek hai jo logon ko sach mein mehsoos hoga.

PulseSoul ki taraf se Naye Saal ki shubhkamnayein.

chat.message: Happy New Year bhai 🎆 Is saal zyada milenge, promise?
